text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a single fan letter arrived
for Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh, much obliged! All right, let's dive right into reading it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see—'Dear Katsuragi Ace-san.
I am a huge fan of yours—'"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I was aiming for the Twinkle Series too, but everyone around me said it was impossible for someone from the countryside, so I was about to give up."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Yet, seeing your powerful running taught me that such notions were mere prejudice, and that I, too, was allowed to dream!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I hope to meet you on the turf someday, Ace-san, for giving me the courage to face any obstacle.
Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Rigid stereotypes and prejudices—those stupid walls...
I was given the power to fight against them...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I gotta send a thank-you reply right away!
And through nothing other than an Ace-worthy run!
choice_data_list: That's the best answer I could ask for!
That's the best answer I could ask for!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: Amazing! That's a new personal best!
Amazing! That's a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Not yet—I'm gonna get way, way faster! Just watch me! This is my true power...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathed fully in the sunset as she tore down the track, Katsuragi Ace was dazzling enough to take one's breath away.
